scope: Several rows of an open list in one message: «1 o 2» / «el primero o el segundo» / «cualquiera» without contact details, and «el 1 y el 2», «1, 2 y 3», «uno de cada uno», «2 de la primera y 1 de la segunda», «una <nombre> y una <nombre>»
trigger: Next priority recorded in batches 80–81 (isolated disjunction, «o» versus «y», quantity per option)
baselineFindings: Agent off: «el primero o el segundo» answered «no manejamos: primero o» and dropped the list; «1 o 2» showed the cart and dropped the list; «cualquiera de los dos» answered «no manejamos: dos»
Agent on: «el primero o el segundo» / «1 o 2» on a replacement list went to the model and the list was lost
«el 1 y el 2» on a two-unit replacement list put both units on the first option; on a plain list it added only the first row; «la 1 y la 3» likewise
«2 de la primera y 1 de la segunda» answered «no manejamos»; «uno de cada uno» was ignored; «1 y 2» answered «¿Qué se te antoja?»
fix: tryResolveSeveralPendingRows runs first inside tryResolvePendingMatchPick. Two references joined by «o/u» (row number, ordinal, code of a listed row) or «cualquiera» keep cart and list and ask, showing those rows with prices. References joined by «,/y/e», «uno de cada uno» or «ambos» (two-row list) buy each row; an optional count per reference («2 de la primera», «una <name>») sets its quantity. A replacement list (or a list for N units without counts) must add up: otherwise it asks how many of each and changes nothing. The first row takes the replaced line; the others inherit its note. A row removed from the menu, a re-priced row on a replacement list, or a row whose product has options stops the purchase with an explanation. Commas are split before normalizing.

contrasts: a single row number still picks only that row
a row whose product has options is not given a silent default
a list for three units with two rows and no counts asks how to split
a row removed from the menu is not bought and nothing else is added
replacement counts that do not add up ask and keep cart and list
